_comment: Lesson 31: a Faust processor written in score's editor and compiled, chained after Lesson 20's sound file and playing. Two hslider declarations in the code produced the two ports the inspector lists. Badges match walkthrough steps 1 (the process placed where audio already arrives), 2 (compile), 3 (the port a declared control produced), and 5 (the filter's cutoff, declared the same way). Re-shot 2026-09-17 with the nodal slot fitted (fourth small icon) so the Faust node title is visible; the editor window (a top-level X window named score) was moved and resized with win.configure to x=1830,y=300,1400x1450 so it sits between the node and the inspector.
